parameters.name: DomainSwitch
parameters.description:
The domain name statistics switch. Valid values:

- on: Enables domain name-level statistics.
- off: User-level data. User-level data is collected by default.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of stream pulling. Specify the time in UTC. The time interval between StartTime and EndTime must be within 30 days, and EndTime must be later than the current time.

parameters.name: Line
parameters.description: The dedicated line. Valid values: integers in the range of [0, 9].

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of stream pulling. Specify the time in UTC. The time interval between StartTime and EndTime must be within 30 days.
